# Rizz Lending

> Rizz Lending is an exotic and luxury auto lender. We finance supercars, luxury cars, and seven-figure hypercars for buyers and work with dealers, auctions, and marketplaces. Fast, private, and built by people who drive these cars.

Rizz Lending LLC (NMLS #2682279). Borrower phone: 801-880-9955. Based in Riverton, Utah. Licensed in a growing list of U.S. states; see the availability page for the current map. NMLS Consumer Access: https://www.nmlsconsumeraccess.org/EntityDetails.aspx/COMPANY/2682279

Vehicles we finance are for personal use only (no rentals, Turo, ride-share, or livery). A business or LLC can own the vehicle if it is not used for hire. Checking eligibility or starting an application does not guarantee that a loan will be issued.

- [Ferrari financing](https://rizzlending.com/ferrari-financing): 296, F8, 812, Roma, Purosangue, and the older V8 and V12 cars.
- [Lamborghini financing](https://rizzlending.com/lamborghini-financing): Huracán, Urus, Aventador, Revuelto, and the older V12s.
- [McLaren financing](https://rizzlending.com/mclaren-financing): 12C, 570S, 720S, 765LT, 750S, Artura, GT, and the Ultimate Series.
- [Bentley financing](https://rizzlending.com/bentley-financing): Continental GT, Flying Spur, and Bentayga.
- [Aston Martin financing](https://rizzlending.com/aston-martin-financing): DB11, DB12, Vantage, DBS, Vanquish, and DBX.
- [Eligibility](https://rizzlending.com/eligibility): What we look at: credit, down payment, income, and the vehicle.
- [Cash-out refinance](https://rizzlending.com/cash-out-refinance): Use equity in a car you already own without selling it.
- [Lease buyout](https://rizzlending.com/lease-buyout): Finance the buyout of an exotic or luxury car you already drive.
